top_issues.issue: Title wordmark overlaps busy scene geometry
top_issues.why: Sign text (FUE, TRADE) and the rig silhouettes cut through the letters, which weakens legibility and the single-focus mood of reference 01
top_issues.suggested_direction: Put the wordmark over sky or a darkened vignette band, or frame the camera so the letters sit on empty sky with the lit pod as the one focal light

top_issues.issue: UI panels and pages carry no light or glow
top_issues.why: The brief says light is gameplay and emissives bloom; the panels are flat dark-slate cards and the ending page is uniform grey, so the UI doesn't share the world's lit-in-the-dark language
top_issues.suggested_direction: Add a faint warm inner glow or edge light keyed to the world hue, a soft bloom on the lumens and accent numerals, and a dim radial warm source behind the ending text

top_issues.issue: Secondary HUD labels too small and dim

top_issues.suggested_direction: Raise size and contrast a step on sub-labels and the cargo list; keep the spacing and corner placement

top_issues.issue: Ore icons muddy and off-palette

top_issues.issue: No emissive glow on any ore
top_issues.why: The art direction says every emissive blooms softly into the dark and light lands. A's ores are flat unlit colour chips and do not light the rock around them.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Add a per-ore inner emissive plus a soft halo, and a warm or cool light pool onto the host rock for the glowing ores (copper, gold, ruby, voidopal, embershard, veinlight, frostbloom, rime salt).

top_issues.issue: Several ores have the wrong colour identity or value
top_issues.why: Copper is brown instead of teal-with-orange, iron is pale grey instead of gunmetal, diamond is cyan, embershard is orange instead of black, and rime salt is grey instead of blue. These break the distinctness pairs.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Re-colour to the brief's table: teal shell on copper, blue-black on iron, near-white on diamond, obsidian black with orange seams on embershard, glacier blue on rime salt.

top_issues.issue: Silhouettes miss the brief
top_issues.why: Silver is sparse slivers rather than a fan, ruby is pebbles rather than hex crystals, gold has no split rock, veinlight is blobs rather than fronds, and nacre is shards rather than a shell.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Build each ore from the brief's silhouette column, and give each a dark rock base so the ore erupts from stone.

top_issues.issue: Mimic tell is weak
top_issues.why: A thin lilac band on an otherwise voidopal-coloured egg is too subtle at gameplay size, so it is unfair to the player.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Add a dark rock husk with red-orange glowing crack lines.

top_issues.issue: Pale ores collapse together at tile size
top_issues.why: Silver, nacre, iron and rime salt are all small, white-grey and matte.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Differentiate them by hue, glow and silhouette as the distinctness pairs specify.

top_issues.issue: Glow halos are clipped to the tile square
top_issues.why: The bloom stops hard at the tile boundary, which makes square glowing panels instead of light softly spilling onto neighbouring rock. On veinlight it becomes an opaque teal tile that swamps the fronds.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Let the halo fall off radially before the tile edge, or extend it past the tile with additive falloff. Lower veinlight's fill intensity so the fronds stay the brightest element.

top_issues.issue: Pale-family halos converge
top_issues.why: Silver, diamond, frostbloom and nacre all wear a similar soft white-lavender halo, so at 40 to 60 px they separate mainly by tiny silhouette differences. The brief says silver has almost no glow and nacre has a sheen, not a hard glow.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Remove or greatly reduce silver's halo and rely on specular edges. Make nacre's halo a faint pearly sheen. Keep the halo for diamond (cool white) and frostbloom (lavender).

top_issues.issue: Iron is nearly invisible at gameplay size
top_issues.why: Dark blue-black on dark rock with tiny glints disappears unless it is lit by the lamp.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Raise the gunmetal value slightly, add a brighter cool rim or specular on the top faces, and use larger glints so it separates from the host rock by shape and spec.

top_issues.issue: Nacre silhouette is off-brief
top_issues.why: It reads as a crystal cluster, which collides with frostbloom and silver, rather than a ribbed scalloped shell fan.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Rebuild nacre as a layered fan or shell with ridges on a slate base, keeping the pastel iridescence.

top_issues.issue: Gold's wound is weak
top_issues.why: The yellow mass is sandwiched between black caps rather than reading as a rock split open with warm light leaking from the crack.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Wrap more dark rock around the gold and expose it through a crack, so the amber glow leaks from inside.

minerals.why: B delivers glow, colour identity and the brief's silhouettes for almost every ore, and gives the mimic a fair tell. A is flat, unlit and mis-coloured, and several pairs are confusable. B's remaining problems are square-clipped halos, converging pale halos and iron's low visibility.
